page_review.title: modern door
page_review.author: Ahmed sayed
page_review.visible_geometry: One modern wood leaf in a frame, with a long vertical pull handle and horizontal inlays. Frame and leaf separation, dimensions and original handedness were not verified.

glb_payload.format_note: Sketchfab converted GLB with 2K textures (5 MB), inferred from the displayed download sizes; the file does not identify its download option.
glb_payload.embedded_images: Four JPEG images in GLB buffer views, no external dependencies; inspected textures reach 2048 x 2048 pixels.

license_scope_review: The page and USDZ agree on Sketchfab Standard. The original CC-only Phase 5.0 rule rejected it. The subsequent local-only rule permits authorized local preparation but prohibits distributing source, normalized geometry or textures as stand-alone assets; the original download remains untouched.
prior_review: The 2026-09-23 CC-only rejection is retained in Git history and superseded solely as a policy decision.
